transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because of my house. Everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure is just about paperwork and missed payments. But I know that's not true. The bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job... they've been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They keep showing me all these papers, but no amount of paperwork changes what I've been seeing going on for almost two years now.
How long have you felt that the bank, the loan servicer, and people at your job have been working together to push you out of your house?

It's been about a year and nine months. That's when the foreclosure notices first showed up and... well, the constant bank calls just started taking over our home life. That's when it became clear what they were really doing.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others around you don't seem to notice?

No, I don't. I mean, I'm not hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there, if that's what you're asking. Everything I'm talking about is completely real. The phone calls, the emails, the way my coworkers act... it's all actually happening right in front of me. I'm just the only one who is actually paying attention and putting the pieces together.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others around you don’t share or seem to understand, outside of what’s happening with your house?

No, not at all. Outside of what's happening with the house and the bank, everything else in my life is completely normal. I mean, I go to work, I manage the floor at the store, I talk to people about regular everyday things, and we all see eye to eye. I don't have any... strange ideas or anything like that. It's really just this one specific situation where people aren't understanding what's actually going on.
Outside of the foreclosure situation, have you ever had any other situations where you believed something was happening that others around you didn’t agree with or understand?

No, I really haven't. Like I said, everything else is just... normal. I've never had any issues like this before the bank started coming after me. There's no other situation where people don't believe me or understand me. It's just this one thing with the house, because they don't see the evidence that I'm seeing every single day.
Outside of the foreclosure issue, have you ever had any other unshakable beliefs that others around you didn’t share or understand, even after being presented with clear evidence to the contrary?

No, I haven't. I feel like I keep answering the same question. There's nothing else. I don't have unshakable beliefs about random things. I just know what's happening with my house because I'm living through it and seeing the proof. Everything else in my life is completely ordinary.

Have you ever had any suspicions or strong beliefs about things other than the foreclosure that you think are completely true, but others don’t seem to agree with you, even after you’ve tried to explain it to them?

I... I really don't know how else to answer this for you. You are asking me the exact same thing again. No. I don't have suspicions about anything else. 

I don't go around making things up or arguing with people over random things. I manage my store, I do my job, and I live a normal life... except for the fact that the bank is doing this to my house. That is the only thing. There is absolutely nothing else.
Have you ever been shown clear evidence that your belief about the foreclosure being part of a coordinated effort was incorrect, and if so, do you still believe it?

They've shown me paperwork, sure. Lots of it. They show me statements and ledgers that say I missed payments, and they act like that's the end of the story. But I know it's not. 

I know the bank, the loan servicer... even people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They can show me all the papers they want, but no amount of paperwork changes what I've been seeing and living through for almost two years. They are coordinating this. I know what I'm seeing.

Even though the bank has shown you paperwork indicating missed payments as the reason for foreclosure, do you still believe that this is actually a coordinated effort against you, despite the evidence they've provided?

Yes. I do. Like I just said, everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure is just about paperwork and missed payments, but I know it's not. I know the bank, the loan servicer, and even people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They can show me all the papers they want, but no amount of papers they show me changes what I’ve been seeing for almost two years.
Can you think of any way that someone could convince you that your belief about the coordinated effort against you is incorrect?

No. There is no way anyone could convince me otherwise, because I know what's happening. I'm here because everyone keeps acting like this foreclosure is just about paperwork and missed payments, but I know the truth. I know the bank, the loan servicer, and even people at my job have been quietly working together to push me out of my house. Like I said, no amount of papers they show me changes what I've been seeing for almost two years. It's real, and I'm not going to let them convince me that I'm crazy for seeing it.
Have you ever had a situation where you realized that your understanding of an event was completely wrong, even though at the time you were absolutely sure you were right?

No, I don't think so. I mean... maybe little things, like misunderstanding a schedule at the store or something minor like that. But a whole event where I was absolutely sure and then turned out to be completely wrong? No, I haven't had that happen. I pay pretty close attention to what goes on around me. So, no, I can't really think of anything like what you're asking about.
